entities.name: UniProt O05508 GmuD
observations: Reviewed Bacillus subtilis 168 protein; exact full-length sequence match to the submitted 465-aa sequence.
Annotated as 6-phospho-beta-glucosidase (EC 3.2.1.86), involved in glucomannan degradation.
Can hydrolyze aryl-phospho-beta-D-glucosides weakly; annotation says its in-vivo role in their degradation is minor, if any.

entities.name: RHEA:10772
observations: Reaction associated with the exact-match GmuD annotation.
